Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to accurately assess the intermediate results provided by the WebSurfer and updated its understanding and decision-making at every iterative step. This resulted in repetitive actions and lack of forward progress, as the new instructions merely duplicated prior searches without addressing the root issue of incomplete information retrieval or changing the approach. Specifically, after the WebSurfer successfully loaded the Wikipedia page (Step 4) which clearly stated "The Bourne Betrayal is the title for the novel by Eric Van Lustbader," the Planner ignored this definitive answer and instead generated a new set of instructions to retry loading the same IMDb page that had previously timed out or failed to show the specific actor. The Planner continued to loop through the same failed strategy (retrying IMDb) instead of synthesizing the available evidence (Wikipedia confirms it's a novel; the only IMDb entry is a 2007 video with no clear "Jason Bourne" actor listed) to provide the correct answer: that there is no widely released film titled "The Bourne Betrayal" and the title character in the main series is played by Matt Damon.
